_comment: AudioMemo 共用字串來源。en、zh-Hant 為已定稿；其他語言在 locales/<語言>.json（AI 初譯，待審）。產生 Mac 的 String Catalog：python3 scripts/gen_strings.py

status.ready.note: 狀態字（錄音面板左上、選單列）

convert.cancelled.en: Conversion cancelled. No file was created.
convert.cancelled.zh-Hant: 已取消轉檔，沒有產生檔案。

convert.noLame.en: The MP3 encoder (LAME) is missing from the app.
convert.noLame.zh-Hant: App 裡缺少 MP3 編碼器（LAME）。

hint.whatIsRecorded.en: Records everything this Mac plays — Zoom, Teams, Meet, videos — plus your microphone.
hint.whatIsRecorded.zh-Hant: 錄下這台 Mac 播出的所有聲音（Zoom、Teams、Meet、影片…）和你的麥克風。

error.playWhileRecording.en: You can't play a recording while recording. Stop recording first.
error.playWhileRecording.zh-Hant: 錄音中不能播放，請先停止錄音。

transcribe.explain.note: 使用者定稿（2026-10-20）：zh-TW 一字不改、Osmi 前後不加空格；其他語言照語意精簡翻（只有這裡提到 Osmi）

delete.message.en: The file will be moved to the Trash.

error.micDenied.en: AudioMemo can't use the microphone. Turn it on in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Microphone.
error.micDenied.zh-Hant: AudioMemo 無法使用麥克風。請到「系統設定 › 隱私權與安全性 › 麥克風」打開。

error.noMic.en: No microphone found. Connect one, or pick one in Settings.
error.noMic.zh-Hant: 找不到麥克風。請接上麥克風，或到「設定」選一支。

error.noAudio.en: Recording didn't start — no sound came in. Please try again.
error.noAudio.zh-Hant: 錄音沒有開始（沒有收到聲音）。請再試一次。

notice.tooShort.en: Recording was too short and wasn't saved.

error.nameExists.en: A recording with this name already exists.

settings.airpodsNote.en: “Same as System” uses the Mac’s current input, and switches to the mic a call app (like Zoom) is using. Bluetooth mics switch audio to call quality.
settings.airpodsNote.zh-Hant: 「跟隨系統」會用 Mac 目前的輸入裝置，並自動跟上視訊 App（例如 Zoom）正在用的麥克風。藍牙麥克風會讓聲音變成通話音質。

settings.autoLevelNote.en: Quiet voices and quiet calls are brought up to a similar level; background noise isn't amplified. Applies to the next recording.
settings.autoLevelNote.zh-Hant: 說話或對方聲音太小時自動拉大到相近的音量，只有背景雜音時不放大。下一次錄音起生效。

settings.folderChoose.zh-Hant: 選擇錄音存放的資料夾

settings.folderChooseMessage.en: New recordings will be saved here. Existing recordings stay where they are.
settings.folderChooseMessage.zh-Hant: 之後的錄音會存到這裡。原本的錄音檔留在原處，不會搬動。

settings.folderNote.en: Changing the folder doesn't move or delete existing recordings.
settings.folderNote.zh-Hant: 換資料夾不會搬動或刪除原本的錄音檔。

settings.folderUnavailable.en: The folder you chose is missing or can't be written to, so recordings are saved to ~/Music/AudioMemo for now.
settings.folderUnavailable.zh-Hant: 你選的資料夾不見了或沒有寫入權限，目前先存到 ~/Music/AudioMemo。

settings.folderNoAccess.en: AudioMemo can't save to that folder. Please choose another one.
settings.folderNoAccess.zh-Hant: AudioMemo 無法存到那個資料夾，請換一個。

notice.followedApp.en: Now using the mic %1$@ is using: %2$@
notice.followedApp.zh-Hant: 已跟上 %1$@ 使用的麥克風：%2$@

notice.followedInUse.en: Now using the mic that's in use: %@
notice.followedInUse.zh-Hant: 已跟上正在使用中的麥克風：%@

notice.deviceLost.en: %@ is unavailable — using the system microphone
notice.deviceLost.zh-Hant: 找不到 %@，改用系統麥克風

notice.bluetooth.en: Bluetooth mics switch recording and headphones to call quality. Use the Mac or iPhone mic instead.
notice.bluetooth.zh-Hant: 藍牙麥克風會讓錄音與耳機變成通話音質，建議改用 Mac 或 iPhone 的麥克風

settings.echoNote.en: Automatic turns it on when sound plays through speakers (so your mic doesn't pick it up again) and off with headphones. While it's on, Control Center › Mic Mode (Voice Isolation, Wide Spectrum) applies to AudioMemo. For a Bluetooth speaker, choose Always On.
settings.echoNote.zh-Hant: 「自動」：用喇叭外放時開啟（麥克風才不會再錄到喇叭的聲音），戴耳機時關閉。開啟時可在控制中心的「麥克風模式」選語音隔離或寬頻。用藍牙喇叭請選「永遠開」。

notice.echoOn.zh-Hant: 已開啟回音消除（喇叭外放）

rename.emptyReverted.en: The name can't be empty — kept the original name
rename.emptyReverted.zh-Hant: 名稱不能空白，已恢復原名

rename.illegalReverted.en: Names can't contain / or : or start with a dot — kept the original name
rename.illegalReverted.zh-Hant: 名稱不能包含 / 或 :，也不能以點開頭，已恢復原名

rename.numbered.en: That name is taken — renamed to %@

notice.uploadDone.zh-Hant: 已上傳，請在瀏覽器完成

osmi.login.note.en: Sign in once to send this recording to Osmi. Your sign-in is remembered.
osmi.login.note.zh-Hant: 登入一次即可把這段錄音送到 Osmi，之後會記住登入狀態。

osmi.login.badResponse.en: Sign-in didn't complete. Please try again.
osmi.login.badResponse.zh-Hant: 登入沒有完成，請再試一次。

NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.en: AudioMemo records your voice from the microphone.
NSMicrophoneUsageDescription.zh-Hant: AudioMemo 會錄下你麥克風的聲音。

NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription.en: AudioMemo records the sound playing on this Mac (meetings, videos).
NSAudioCaptureUsageDescription.zh-Hant: AudioMemo 會錄下這台 Mac 播出的聲音（會議、影片）。
